x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/ and lib/Settings/example-sets/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change document-accessibility-check task 9 (REQ-005). One accessibility-override record per publication that went ahead past the document accessibility gate, written by DocumentPublicationGate through AccessibilityOverrideLog. The override itself stays where task 6 put it (the meeting's accessibilityOverrides, the publication record's accessibilityOverride); this record only makes the overrides countable per body and period by OpenRegister's aggregation endpoint, which the meeting's array and the publication record's object are not.

AccessibilityOverride.title: Accessibility override
AccessibilityOverride.description: A publication that went ahead past the document accessibility check: who, why, when, for which body, and the scan reports concerned. Written by the system on publication; counted by the accessibility report.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the publication went ahead past the accessibility check.

actor.title: By
actor.description: The user who published past the check.

overriddenAt.title: At
overriddenAt.description: When the publication went ahead past the check.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: The body whose meeting the published documents belong to, for the per-body report.

sourceObject.title: Source object
sourceObject.description: The meeting, agenda item or decision whose documents were published.

sourceSchema.title: Source type
sourceSchema.description: The kind of record the documents are attached to.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: The scan reports of the documents published past the check.

documentCount.title: Documents
documentCount.description: How many documents were published past the check.

AccessibilityOverride._authorizationNote: Written only by AccessibilityOverrideLog (through DocumentPublicationGate, when a publication goes ahead past the gate) with _rbac false. No write verb on the object API, so nobody can add or remove an override the report counts; a reason and an actor are for signed-in users only.
